meta.subtitle: DORA Metrics & Support KPIs
notes: Thresholds and targets below are taken from the Power BI screenshots; edit freely.
leadTime.seedValue and coverage are SEED data (not in the workbooks) — wired to Azure DevOps in Phase 2.
Rates and coverage are stored as fractions 0..1 and formatted as % in the UI.

categories.label: System Issues
categories.definition: Reported issue with the system, and it's within SettleIT's control to rectify. e.g. a bug, system unstable, or an outage.

categories.label: Support Tasks
categories.definition: Not an issue, but an action required from the support team. e.g. revert an order status, enable client for manual service.

categories.label: User Issues
categories.definition: Not an issue with the system — a training issue, the user is unaware of behaviour, or a misdirected email. e.g. email to the wrong inbox, feature request.

categories.label: Other System Issues
categories.definition: An integrated/external system not working as expected. e.g. InfoTrackID / EAM / PEXA outage, LEAP, Smokeball.

calendar.comment: InfoTrack FY starts in July; the year is split into Thirds (T1 Jul–Oct, T2 Nov–Feb, T3 Mar–Jun).
